Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly asserted that Taylor Swift’s “Safe & Sound” was directed by Roman White, using that false claim to rule out Swift and pivot to Harry Styles. This ignored available evidence that Yoann Lemoine (Woodkid) actually directed Taylor Swift’s “Back to December,” an orchestral country pop ballad. The misidentification led directly to the wrong final artist.
